Package com.smu.mysql

Class MTC_Data_Dao_MySQL

java.lang.Object
com.smu.mysql.MTC_Data_Dao_MySQL
All Implemented Interfaces:
MTC_AppendOnly_Data_Dao, DaoSupport, MTC_Data_Dao<MTC_AppendOnly_Node_Record,MTC_AppendOnly_Index>, Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class MTC_Data_Dao_MySQL extends Object implements MTC_AppendOnly_Data_Dao, DaoSupport, Closeable
MySQL 8 implementation of the Data Access Object for Merkle Tree operations, backed by a HikariCP connection pool. This is the production implementation; unlike the SQLite reference implementation, it does not create its tables — certs/nodes/states (and pending_certs) are provisioned separately (see sql/pending_certs.sql and CLAUDE.md).

Implements Closeable to release the underlying connection pool; callers (in particular the one-shot MTC_BuildRunner) must close it before the process exits.

    • attach

      public <X> X attach(Class<X> extensionType)
      Obtains a DAO extension bound to the current transaction if inTransaction(com.smu.mtc.mtcbean.DaoSupport.TxAction<T>) is active on this thread, or a standalone on-demand extension otherwise. Exposed so that callers outside this class (namely MTC_BuildRunner) can operate on the pending_certs queue table, via PendingCertDao, in the very same transaction as the MTC_Service.build() call it wraps.
      Type Parameters:
      X - the DAO extension type.
      Parameters:
      extensionType - the DAO interface class, e.g. PendingCertDao.class.
      Returns:
      the extension instance to invoke DAO methods on.

    • inTransaction

      public <T> T inTransaction(DaoSupport.TxAction<T> action) throws Exception
      Executes action as a single atomic database transaction. Every MTC_Data_Dao call made (directly or indirectly, e.g. via MTC_Service_AppendOnly.build(java.util.ArrayList<com.smu.mtc.mtcbean.MTC_Cert_Record>, long)) from within action on this same instance participates in that one transaction; if action throws, all of its writes are rolled back.

      This matters once the DAO is backed by a networked database (e.g. MySQL): build() performs several dependent writes (node updates, cert inserts, node inserts, state insert) that must land together or not at all, otherwise a mid-batch failure (network blip, crash) can leave the state chain half-built.

      Specified by:
      inTransaction in interface DaoSupport
      Type Parameters:
      T - the result type produced by action.
      Parameters:
      action - the unit of work to run inside the transaction.
      Returns:
      whatever action returns.
      Throws:
      Exception - if action throws, or the transaction itself fails to commit.
